newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia allows private imports of corn, soy pellet.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia allows private imports of corn, soy pellet.

text.p: Tunisia has issued a regulation removing the state monopoly on imports of cereals by allowing private traders to import corn and soy pellets, grain traders said on Tuesday.
The move was published in the Official Gazette issue received on Tuesday.
The legislation includes a regulation under which traders must obtain licence to import maize and soy pellets, and details quality to be met for entry into Tunisia.

"This is a privatisation move. The state-run Office des Cereales which until now had a monopoly on grains imports will now be an operator like other traders for import of corn and soy pellets," a trader told Reuters.
He said that the liberalisation includes import, marketing and prices of these two products and a state committee will control their quality.
The Office des Cereales will keep its monopoly for the import of other cereals such as wheat and barley.
